title: Five good minutes
intro: Five little things worth knowing today.

items.q: Which animal has fingerprints so similar to humans they can confuse investigators?
items.why: Koalas have ridged fingerprints remarkably similar to ours—even under a microscope.

items.q: Which planet would float in water, if you had a bathtub large enough?
items.why: Saturn's average density is lower than water's.

items.q: What do sea stars use hundreds of tiny tube feet for?
items.why: Their tube feet are hydraulic multitaskers used for movement, handling food and sensing their surroundings.

items.q: About how long does sunlight take to reach Earth?
items.why: Sunlight takes roughly 8 minutes and 20 seconds to reach Earth.

items.q: What is the largest ocean on Earth?
items.why: The Pacific is Earth's largest and deepest ocean.
